videos.label: Burp Repeater
videos.title: How to resend individual requests with Burp Repeater
videos.creator: PortSwigger
videos.why: A focused request-edit-send-compare demonstration, including response history, redirects and reusable tabs. Directly useful for manual web challenges.
videos.caution: Older UI; use Community manual features. The included local HTTP worksheet provides a target.
videos.review_basis: Full extracted English caption text read; not a full audiovisual watch. Segment boundaries approximate.

videos.label: CyberChef
videos.title: Cryptography   Lab 5   Cooking with the Cyberchef
videos.creator: Level Effect
videos.why: Shows recipe ordering, reversible transformations, Magic suggestions and a layered deobfuscation workflow. More instructive than a list of operations.
videos.caution: The second example uses a course-provided file; watch the reasoning or recreate your own data. Encoding heuristics are clues, not proof.
videos.review_basis: Full extracted English caption text read; not a full audiovisual watch. Segment boundaries approximate.

videos.label: Ghidra
videos.title: Ghidra quickstart & tutorial: Solving a simple crackme
videos.creator: stacksmashing
videos.why: Shows import/analysis, the decompiler, correcting function types, renaming, comments and recovering a simple input condition. Strong first-tool walkthrough.
videos.caution: 2019 interface. Skip the historical scrolling patch; use the bundled benign C program for practice.
videos.review_basis: Full extracted English caption text read; not a full audiovisual watch. Segment boundaries approximate.

videos.label: GDB / control flow
videos.title: Reversing and Cracking first simple Program - bin 0x05
videos.creator: LiveOverflow
videos.why: Builds a control-flow sketch, uses breakpoints and instruction stepping, then tests the comparison by changing a register. Strong reasoning complement to Ghidra.
videos.caution: Addresses are example-specific. Hopper/IDA appear only as comparisons, not required approved tools. Creator caption track runs beyond the video; use the saved automatic track.
videos.review_basis: Full extracted English caption text read; not a full audiovisual watch. Segment boundaries approximate.

videos.label: MFTECmd / Timeline Explorer
videos.title: Introduction to MFTECmd - NTFS MFT and Journal Forensics
videos.creator: 13Cubed
videos.why: Connects MFT/journal concepts to CSV parsing, timestamp interpretation and tracing a file through renames and deletion. Especially relevant to the forensic worksheet.
videos.caution: Skip 06:00–10:30 KAPE acquisition: that separate tool is not added to approval. Historical lack of $LogFile support is outdated; group by entry and sequence to avoid reuse confusion.
videos.review_basis: Full extracted English caption text read; not a full audiovisual watch. Segment boundaries approximate.

videos.label: Volatility 3
videos.title: Introduction to Memory Forensics with Volatility 3
videos.creator: DFIRScience
videos.why: A substantial process→handles→file extraction investigation, followed by command lines, network relationships and registry artifacts. Best breadth among the selected memory videos.
videos.caution: Skip old installation steps. Commands in automatic captions are unreliable; verify current plugin spelling/help. IP/name correlations are leads, not attribution proof.
videos.review_basis: Full extracted English caption text read; not a full audiovisual watch. Segment boundaries approximate.

videos.label: RSA with Python / Sage
videos.title: CTFlearn: RSA Beginner
videos.creator: Almond Force
videos.why: Explains factoring a weak modulus, totient, modular inverse, decryption and byte conversion. Useful when rusty on the math.
videos.caution: Not a demonstration of RsaCtfTool. Uses online SageCell; use the bundled local toy example instead of uploading event data.
videos.review_basis: Full extracted English caption text read; not a full audiovisual watch. Segment boundaries approximate.

videos.label: Audio stego / Sonic Visualiser / ExifTool
videos.title: MORSE CODE Steganography (2/2) BsidesCT CTF 2018
videos.creator: John Hammond
videos.why: Shows correcting an initial audio hypothesis and using metadata, then recognizing layered encodings. Useful as a thought-process example.
videos.caution: Most decoding uses online services and exploratory detours. Not a focused Sonic Visualiser tutorial or a directly reproducible offline workflow; skip the outro.
videos.review_basis: Full extracted English caption text read; not a full audiovisual watch. Segment boundaries approximate.
